observations: A large rectangular form dominates the center, outlined in thick black, with yellow block shapes arranged in a grid across its right half and a tightly wound black-and-white spiral near its center.
Loose lines in red, green, yellow, and blue cross the surface in all directions, layering over and under the black structure without following its edges.

A horizontal band of white and black vertical stripes sits low in the composition, flanked by red marks, while a flat cyan field fills the background and wraps around the outer edges of the central form.
reading: The black-outlined rectangle holds its ground while colored lines run freely across it, ignoring its borders. The spiral near center pulls the eye inward against the grid of yellow blocks pushing outward. That tension—containment versus scatter—gives the image an unsettled feeling, as though two ordering systems compete for the same space. The low striped band reads as a base, grounding what spreads above it.
